description:
His owners called him “old and aggressive.” He was only 6 and just wanted to be loved 💔

Finn had spent all six years of his life chained outside when his owners got a younger dog and wanted him put down. But when @SidewalkSpecials took him in, Rachael couldn't believe the affectionate dog in front of her had really spent his entire life on a chain. Dodo producer Valentina shares how Finn finally got his chance at a real home, with a family who already had a very familiar-looking Sidewalk Specials alum.

Hosted and Produced by Valentina
fulltitle: Owners Wanted Their 6-Year-Old Dog Put Down After Replacing Him | The Dodo
creator: The Dodo, Sidewalk Specials
